name: lookup_vehicle
title: Look Up Vehicle
description: Look up a ThunderCats 5.5E vehicle or its combat rules (Bedlam, ThunderTank, Hover Cat, and other Third Earth craft) and return its attributes, components, and travel or combat rules. Use when: resolving a vehicle's statistics, crew, or chase/combat behaviour from the ThunderCats Campaign and Setting Guide. Do NOT use when: looking up a creature or a magic item — use lookup_monster or lookup_magic_item; or when the vehicle name is unknown — use search_rules. Mutation class: read-only — reads the bound ruleset's indexed data only; writes no state, emits no audit entry, and changes no badge. Returns: the vehicle entry with its source anchor, or [ERROR] [NOT_FOUND] with a 'Did you mean?' hint and the valid names.

key.description: Vehicle name or rule topic (e.g. 'bedlam', 'thundertank', 'vehicle travel').

name: lookup_equipment

Do NOT use when: looking up a magic item or vehicle — use lookup_magic_item or lookup_vehicle; or when the item name is unknown — use search_rules. Mutation class: read-only — reads the bound ruleset's indexed data only; writes no state, emits no audit entry, and changes no badge. Returns: the equipment entry with its source anchor, or [ERROR] [NOT_FOUND] with a 'Did you mean?' hint and the valid names.

key.description: Equipment, device, or invention name (e.g. 'thundrillium', 'adventuring gear').
